author: reek
body: Grounding is SCOPED to the named effects. This chapter grounds Device.Mmio but performs port-out-byte (a [Device.Port] intrinsic), so Device.Port is neither declared nor grounded, and touch is rejected with CDX2031. A chapter cannot launder some other hardware effect through the exemption it took for a different one. Note the exemption flag is on -- the effectful let is not a CDX2033 here -- yet the scoped row check still catches the wrong effect.
